panels.title: Drawdown (MTM, governs the hard stop)
panels.description: Peak-to-now on MARK-TO-MARKET equity — the basis the catastrophe hard stop and the sizer throttle actually use. This panel previously plotted liquiditybot_drawdown_pct, which measures from STARTING CAPITAL on cash+savings only and ignores unrealized loss: the description said 'peak-to-now' while the metric said something else, so a book underwater on marks could read calm here while the throttle was already biting.
